prose: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, touting 'fast and capable computer use at scale' and clearer, more natural writing, priced at $1 per million input and $5 per million output tokens. The positioning - computer use plus aggressive pricing - is a direct move on the agentic-workload segment Anthropic's Claude Code currently owns.
